refunds.title: Failed top-ups and refunds
refunds.heading: How long a refund takes
refunds.text: If money left your bank account or card for a top-up that then failed, the provider returns it. Refunds to UPI and bank accounts take 1 to 3 business days; refunds to cards take 5 to 7 business days, depending on the card issuer. The ledger does not hold the money at any point during a refund.

pendingTopups.title: Pending, posted and failed
pendingTopups.heading: Top-ups
pendingTopups.text: A top-up starts pending and becomes posted when the provider confirms it, or failed when the provider reports a failure. A pending top-up is not part of your balance.

duplicates.title: Duplicate payments and retries
duplicates.heading: Why you never pay twice
duplicates.text: Every transfer request carries an idempotency key. If a request is sent again with the same key, for example after a network timeout, the ledger returns the original result instead of moving money a second time.
